channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Rijksmuseum Meermanno x Amarte: new work on Power and Powerlessness (The Hague; EUR 8,500 fee plus EUR 4,000 production budget) (closes 24 Nov)
item.description:
Amarte Fonds and Rijksmuseum Meermanno, House of the Book
Deadline: 24 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 8,500 artist's fee plus a EUR 4,000 production budget, with content support during the research and artistic guidance. The artwork remains the artist's property. No application fee mentioned.

Amarte and Rijksmuseum Meermanno, the museum of the book in The Hague, select one artist for a research and work period in the museum's collection, ending in an exhibition. The museum's 2027 programme theme is Power and Powerlessness, and applicants are encouraged to connect with it.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Theatertreffen International Forum 2027, Berlin: 18-day scholarship for emerging theatre makers (all costs covered, no stipend) (closes 26 Nov)
item.description:
Berliner Festspiele, Theatertreffen, with the Goethe-Institut, Pro Helvetia and partners
Deadline: 26 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: NO CASH STIPEND; listed as a deliberate exception. The scholarship covers all participation costs: festival tickets, travel, Berlin public transport, shared accommodation, catering or a per diem, travel and health insurance and visa fees for those not resident in Berlin. No application fee mentioned.

Around 30 theatre makers at the start of their practice spend the whole of Theatertreffen 2027 in Berlin together: watching the invited productions, taking workshops with artists, joining artist talks and excursions, and meeting the festival director and jury.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: NeverAtHome International Open Call 2027: 27 Artists, 27 Destinations (Austria-based artists; EUR 6,700 per project plus a funded trip) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
NeverAtHome, with the Austrian Federal Ministry for European and International Affairs and the Austrian Cultural Forums
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 6,700 per project, including artist fee, production and presentation costs. Travel and accommodation for one presentation trip are covered on top. No application fee mentioned.

Twenty-seven artists based in Austria each develop a new work in dialogue with the local context of one of 27 cities that host an Austrian Cultural Forum, present it there during 2027, and then show together in Vienna in 2028.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: BPD Cultuurfonds: sponsorship for art in public space (up to EUR 70,000 per project; round closing 1 December 2026) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Stichting BPD Cultuurfonds
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 12:00 CET
Award: Up to EUR 70,000 excluding VAT per project or project component, paid 80% at the start of execution and 20% after completion and the final report. The fund does not cover full costs: the funding plan must show a real shortfall and other contributions. Applicants' own fees are not covered. No application fee mentioned.

BPD Cultuurfonds sponsors publicly accessible art and culture projects in the Netherlands that improve the quality and experience of public or semi-public space. This is the route for large outdoor installations and artworks tied to a place.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Sample-Studios Matheson Digital Artist Bursary Award (EUR 5,000 plus solo shows at Beta Festival Dublin and in Cork) (closes 2 Dec)
item.description:
Sample-Studios (Cork) with Matheson LLP
Deadline: 2 Dec 2026, 13:00 GMT
Award: EUR 5,000 bursary, a one-year Sample-Studios Associate Membership for 2027, a solo exhibition at Beta Festival Dublin in November 2027 (or culminating events) and a solo exhibition at The Lord Mayor's Pavilion, Cork, in early 2028. No application fee stated.

A year-long award for a digital artist from Sample-Studios in Cork, backed by the law firm Matheson as its digital arts partner and linked to Beta Festival, Dublin's art and technology festival.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ZMINA: Resilience, Co-Creation Funding of International Cooperation Projects (Second Call, up to EUR 25,000) (closes 4 Dec)
item.description:
IZOLYATSIA Foundation (UA), Malý Berlín (SK), Trans Europe Halles (SE)
Deadline: 4 Dec 2026, 23:59 EET
Award: Up to EUR 25,000 per project, covering up to 90% of costs; partners add at least 10% in cash. EUR 187,500 in total for an expected 7 to 10 grants. No application fee mentioned.

Second co-creation call of ZMINA: Resilience, which funds new work made jointly by Ukrainian and European cultural organisations on the theme of resilience. Any art form is eligible except audiovisual, so theatre, performance, installation and interdisciplinary projects all fit.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ZMINA: Resilience, International Showcasing of Co-Creation Projects (Round 2, up to EUR 50,000) (closes 14 Dec)
item.description:
IZOLYATSIA Foundation (UA), Malý Berlín (SK), Trans Europe Halles (SE)
Deadline: 14 Dec 2026
Award: Up to EUR 50,000 per project, covering up to 90% of costs; applicants must add at least 10% in cash. EUR 950,000 in total for an expected 19 to 25 grants.

Rolling call that funds public showcasing tours of artistic and cultural works co-created by Ukrainian organisations and partners from other Creative Europe countries, on the theme of resilience.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fonds Podiumkunsten: Productiesubsidie 2027, round 1 (up to EUR 78,750 per production, EUR 105,000 with 50% own income) (closes 6 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL)
Deadline: 6 Jan 2027, 23:59 CET
Award: Up to EUR 78,750 per production; up to EUR 105,000 if the production covers at least 50% of its costs from own income; up to EUR 52,500 for a concours. Up to EUR 26,250 extra for a new composition, libretto or theatre text. At least 20% of production costs must come from own income. No application fee mentioned.

The Performing Arts Fund's main production grant, and the largest single-project subsidy for theatre and performance in the Netherlands. It funds new productions, reprises, coproductions and concours in the professional performing arts.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: vfonds: Onze Democratie and Onze Vrijheid project grants (rolling under EUR 50,000; larger grants due 14 January 2027) (closes 14 Jan 2027)
item.description:
vfonds (Nationaal Fonds voor Vrede, Vrijheid en Veteranenzorg)
Deadline: 14 Jan 2027
Award: No published maximum. Requests under EUR 50,000 are rolling; requests of EUR 50,000 or more go to four fixed rounds a year. vfonds covers at most 50% of project costs. No application fee mentioned.

Two parallel schemes for public projects about democracy, the rule of law and freedom, and one of the few large Dutch funders where justice themes are the point of the call.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Screen Ireland Focus Shorts: live-action short film scheme (budgets of up to EUR 70,000) (closes 29 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Screen Ireland (Fís Éireann)
Deadline: 29 Jan 2027, 13:00 GMT
Award: Production budget of up to EUR 70,000 per film. Writer, director and producer fees are budgeted at 8 to 10% of the total. No application fee stated.

Focus Shorts is Screen Ireland's scheme for live-action fiction short films of up to 10 minutes, in English or Irish. WHO: teams of producer, director and writer, where the producer and director are different people.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Gemeente Den Haag: Arts and Culture Projects 2027, spring windows (Category A up to EUR 10,000, Category B up to EUR 30,000) (closes 15 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Gemeente Den Haag (Haagse Kunst- en Cultuurprojecten)
Deadline: 15 Feb 2027, 23:59 CET
Award: Category A: EUR 2,000 to EUR 10,000, covering at most 70% of the budget (open to individuals). Category B: EUR 10,000 to EUR 30,000, covering at most 30% of the budget (legal entities only). No application fee mentioned.

The City of The Hague's project subsidy for public-facing work in theatre, music, dance, film, literature, visual arts or any combination. WHO: professional arts organisations, broedplaatsen and artists active in The Hague.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fonds Podiumkunsten: Urban Arts Projects 2027 (rolling from 1 January; up to EUR 15,000 for individuals, EUR 25,000 for collectives)
item.description:
Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Up to EUR 15,000 for individuals and up to EUR 25,000 for companies and collectives, for time, materials and third-party services. No application fee mentioned.

A project grant for theatre, dance, music and spoken-word makers rooted in urban culture who are established in their own scene but have not yet broken through nationally. The 2026 budget is spent; applications reopen on 1 January 2027 and are then handled continuously while the budget lasts.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: TBG+S / TOKAS International Residency Exchange 2027: three months in Tokyo for an Irish or Ireland-based visual artist (closes 27 Nov)
item.description:
Temple Bar Gallery + Studios (Dublin) with Tokyo Arts and Space (TOKAS)
Deadline: 27 Nov 2026, 17:00 GMT
Award: A stipend covering living and working expenses, travel to and from Tokyo, and on-site single-room accommodation. The stipend amount is not given on the call page. No application fee stated.

Temple Bar Gallery + Studios in Dublin sends one visual artist to Tokyo Arts and Space for a three-month residency in autumn 2027, as part of its exchange with TOKAS. WHO: professional practising visual artists who either live in Ireland or are Irish and live anywhere in the world.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IAS CEU: Global Invisible University Artist and Writer in Residence Fellowships 2027/28 (Budapest, EUR 2,000 a month) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Institute for Advanced Study, Central European University (IAS CEU)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: Net allowance of EUR 2,000 a month, plus accommodation at the Raoul Wallenberg Guesthouse and/or office space at IAS CEU as available. Travel and health insurance are not covered.

Two residential fellowships within the Global Invisible University programme: one Writer in Residence (poetry, prose, drama, screen and playwriting) and one Visual or New Media Artist in Residence (from painting and film to digital art, computer graphics and interactive art).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Humboldt Residency Programme 2027, "Oceanic Horizons: The Future of our Blue Planet" (funded six-week residency for researchers, creatives and practitioners) (closes 14 Dec)
item.description:
Alexander von Humboldt Foundation
Deadline: 14 Dec 2026
Award: Monthly allowance for the six-week residency (figure not published: researchers get standard Humboldt fellowship rates, creatives and practitioners a competitive honorarium), travel allowance to and from Germany, accommodation at Schloss Wiepersdorf and a Berlin aparthotel, and a budget for public formats. No family allowance. No application fee.

Each year the Humboldt Foundation brings twelve people from research, the arts and civil society together to work on one topic and find new ways of communicating it to audiences beyond academia. The 2027 topic is Oceanic Horizons: The Future of our Blue Planet.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.description:
RIXC Center for New Media Culture

RIXC, the Riga centre for new media culture, offers five fully funded two-month residencies under the title Northern Climate Practices, supported by the Nordic-Baltic Mobility Programme for Culture. WHO: professional artists from the Nordic and Baltic countries.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ligeti zentrum Artists and Scientists in Residence 2027, Where Sound Shapes Space (Hamburg; EUR 1,200 a month plus accommodation) (closes 10 Jan 2027)

ligeti zentrum (Hamburg University of Music and Theatre, HAW Hamburg and partners)

Fifth round of the ligeti zentrum's artistic-scientific residency in Hamburg. Each resident joins one of four running projects on sound and space.

Centre Culturel Irlandais (Paris)

The Irish cultural centre in Paris hosts artists in residence each year, funded by Ireland's Department of Foreign Affairs. NOT YET OPEN: the call opens on 2 December 2026 and closes on 14 January 2027.

item.description:
ISELP (Institut Supérieur pour l'Étude du Langage Plastique), with the Commission communautaire française (COCOF)
Deadline: 17 Jan 2027, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 2,500 bursary, plus a workspace and mentoring for three months

Three-month residency at ISELP in Brussels for an artist or collective working in visual or audiovisual arts whose process involves dialogue with a group of people who are not art professionals. The project must take place in Brussels.

item.title: Région Sud: Carte blanche aux artistes, Arts visuels (creation grant of up to EUR 10,000 via associations in Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur) (closes 17 Jan 2027)

Région Sud Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur (Service création artistique)

item.title: SAC International Curatorial Residency Program 2027, Barcelona (EUR 2,000 honorarium, EUR 2,000 production fund, travel and accommodation) (closes 31 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Sant Andreu Contemporani, with Fabra i Coats - Fàbrica de Creació de Barcelona
Deadline: 31 Jan 2027, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 2,000 curator honorarium, EUR 2,000 exhibition production fund and EUR 700 for travel and expenses (all subject to tax), plus accommodation and a workspace. Each selected artist is paid EUR 500. No application fee mentioned.

Sant Andreu Contemporani, with Fabra i Coats, invites one international curator to Barcelona to sit on the jury of the Miquel Casablancas Prize for the Visual Arts 2027 and then build a curatorial project with four Catalan artists, or artists linked to the Catalan context, chosen from the prize's...

item.title: Gjon Mili Residency 2027: 25-day moving-image residency in Dhërmi, Albania (EUR 1,000 artist fee plus EUR 40 a day) (closes 10 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Gjon Mili Video Art Festival
Deadline: 10 Feb 2027
Award: EUR 1,000 artist fee plus EUR 40 a day in daily support for 25 days (EUR 1,000 in total), up to EUR 200 for installation materials, shared groceries (EUR 300 for the three residents together), accommodation, and a contribution towards international travel to Tirana (amount not published). Application fee USD 25, non-refundable.

The Gjon Mili Video Art Festival is launching its first residency, bringing three artists to the coastal village of Dhërmi in southern Albania for 25 days in May 2027. WHO: individual artists of any nationality and at any career stage. Duos and teams cannot be accepted.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: MOPGA 2027: Visiting Fellowship Program for Early Career Researchers (France) (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Campus France, for the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Space
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026
Award: EUR 2,500 a month for 12 months, plus a EUR 500 settling-in allowance and health, civil liability and repatriation insurance. International travel is not covered.

Tenth call of Make Our Planet Great Again, a French government visiting fellowship for early career researchers to spend 12 months in a French laboratory.

item.title: Fonds BJP Press Play 2027: Development Programme for Journalistic Makers (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Fonds BJP (Fonds voor Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 3,200 towards about 20 days of time invested, plus a personal coach and workshops. No application fee.

Press Play helps makers develop and pitch a journalistic or creative project, with five places in each of four tracks: audio, video, writing and photo.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Mondriaan Fund: Call for Proposals, Dutch Pavilion at the Venice Biennale Arte 2028 (EUR 500,000 presentation budget) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Mondriaan Fund
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 16:00 CET
Award: EUR 500,000 (incl. VAT, excl. fees) presentation budget for the selected team; up to 4 shortlisted teams receive EUR 5,000 each to develop their plan.

The first open call for the Dutch entry to the Venice Biennale Arte since 2018, run by the Mondriaan Fund for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: AFK Amsterdam Fund for the Arts: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (closes 2 Dec)
item.description:
Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK)
Deadline: 2 Dec 2026, 15:00 CET
Award: Category 1: EUR 1,500 to 2,500; category 2: EUR 2,500 to 7,500; category 3: EUR 7,500 to 17,500 (includes artistic development, replacing the old stipend); category 4: EUR 17,500 and up. No application fee.

The general Amsterdam project grant for individuals, collectives and organisations living or working in Amsterdam or nearby municipalities, across disciplines including digital and media work.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Danish Arts Foundation (Statens Kunstfond): Production and Exhibitions, visual arts (1 January 2027 round) (closes 1 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Danish Arts Foundation (Statens Kunstfond)
Deadline: 1 Jan 2027, 14:00 CET
Award: No maximum stated; the committee may award less than requested. Covers production of new work, exhibition costs, promotion, and production and exhibition honoraria for the artist. No application fee.

The Danish Arts Foundation funds producing, showing and promoting contemporary visual art in Denmark and abroad.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: CNC Fonds d'aide au jeu video (FAJV), session of 18 January 2027 (France, games studios) (closes 18 Jan 2027)
item.description:
CNC (Centre national du cinema et de l'image animee)
Deadline: 18 Jan 2027
Award: No fixed figure: up to 100 percent of costs for writing, 50 percent for pre-production and production. The June 2026 session awarded EUR 10,000 per writing project, EUR 25,000 to 150,000 for pre-production and EUR 80,000 to 200,000 for production. No application fee.

France's FAJV gives selective grants for the writing, pre-production and production of video games, plus support for collective operations such as events. ELIGIBILITY: games companies established in France; suitable for studios, not individual artists.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Creative Europe MEDIA: Films on the Move 2027 (up to 90 percent of costs for sales agents coordinating cross-border film releases) (closes 21 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Creative Europe MEDIA (European Commission / EACEA)
Deadline: 21 Jan 2027, 17:00 CET
Award: Grant of up to 90 percent of total project costs with no fixed request limit; 70 percent prefinancing. Support passed on to distributors is capped per territory (for example EUR 150,000 in DE/FR/IT/ES and EUR 60,000 in AT/BE/NL/PL for films up to EUR 15 million; double for animation and bigger films). Total call budget EUR 23,500,000. No application fee.

Films on the Move (CREA-MEDIA-2027-FILMOVE) supports the cinema and online distribution of non-national European films across borders, and encourages subtitling, dubbing and audio description.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fonds Darstellende Kuenste: Produktionsfoerderung, round 01/2027 (EUR 15,000 to 50,000 for independent performing arts) (closes 25 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Fonds Darstellende Kuenste
Deadline: 25 Jan 2027
Award: EUR 15,000 to 50,000 per production. At least 50 percent of the requested amount must already be approved from German municipal and/or state public funds. No application fee.

The federal fund for independent performing arts supports new productions by professional artists and ensembles based in Germany, with grants of EUR 15,000 to 50,000 per production.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Austria: Startstipendien for Film Art 2027 (BMWKMS) (closes 31 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Austrian Federal Ministry for Arts and Culture (BMWKMS)
Deadline: 31 Jan 2027
Award: Six grants of EUR 9,000, plus family supplements of EUR 200 to 400 per month. No application fee.

Start-up grants for emerging filmmakers to develop a feature-length fiction, documentary, hybrid, animated or experimental project, with a mandatory companion programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Austria: Startstipendien for Visual Art, Design, Photography and Media Art 2027 (BMWKMS) (closes 31 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Austrian Federal Ministry for Arts and Culture (BMWKMS)
Deadline: 31 Jan 2027
Award: 23 grants of EUR 9,000 for six months, plus EUR 200 per month for single parents or families on increased family allowance (EUR 400 if both apply). No application fee.

Start-up grants from the Austrian arts ministry for emerging artists, with media art as one of four named disciplines alongside visual art, design and photography (apply in one discipline only).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: OCA International Support, February 2027 round (travel and production support for Norway-based artists abroad) (closes 3 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Office for Contemporary Art Norway (OCA)
Deadline: 3 Feb 2027, 23:59 CET
Award: Travel support and production support; the 2026 budgets were NOK 2,300,000 (travel) and NOK 3,200,000 (production) across three rounds. No per-grant figure published. No application fee.

OCA administers Norwegian state funds that help Norway-based art practitioners present work abroad. Travel support covers travel costs; production support covers making work for an international exhibition or project.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Creative Europe MEDIA: TV and Online Content 2027 (lump sums of EUR 70,000 to 2 million for fiction, animation and documentary production) (closes 10 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Creative Europe MEDIA (European Commission / EACEA)
Deadline: 10 Feb 2027, 17:00 CET
Award: Fixed lump sum set by total production budget: EUR 70,000 (budget up to EUR 500,000) rising through EUR 150,000, 300,000 and 500,000 to EUR 1 million (budget over EUR 10 million) and EUR 2 million (budget over EUR 20 million). Total call budget EUR 23,300,000 (animation 5.8 million, documentary 1.9 million, fiction 15.6 million). No application fee.

The MEDIA TV and Online Content call (CREA-MEDIA-2027-TVONLINE) funds the production of high-quality, innovative TV works and serial storytelling for linear and online release, made by independent European production companies with strong potential to circulate across Europe and beyond.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Cultural Bridge 2027-28, Round 6: UK-Germany partnerships in social and community arts (up to GBP 30,000) (closes 10 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Cultural Bridge (British Council, Goethe-Institut, Fonds Soziokultur and the four UK arts councils)
Deadline: 10 Feb 2027, 12:00 GMT
Award: Up to GBP 30,000 per partnership plus access costs, from a GBP 360,000 pot (about 12 awards). No application fee.

Cultural Bridge funds partnerships between UK and German arts organisations working in social and community arts practice. Round 6 is limited to established (Tier 2) partnerships with a track record of working together.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Creative Europe MEDIA: Audience Development and Film Education 2027 (up to 70 percent of costs, EUR 7 million call) (closes 2 Mar 2027)
item.description:
Creative Europe MEDIA (European Commission / EACEA)
Deadline: 2 Mar 2027, 17:00 CET
Award: Grant of up to 70 percent of total project costs; no fixed maximum per project given in the summary. Total call budget EUR 7,000,000, with about 15 projects expected. No application fee.

The MEDIA Audience Development and Film Education call (CREA-MEDIA-2027-AUDFILMEDU) funds projects that build public interest in, and knowledge of, European films and audiovisual works, including a dedicated strand for film heritage.

item.description:
Creative Europe MEDIA (European Commission / EACEA)
Deadline: 17 Jun 2027, 17:00 CEST
Award: Up to EUR 800,000 per project, co-financing up to 70 percent of eligible costs. The amount is generated from cinema and online admissions sold in 2026 for the agent's European films. Total call budget EUR 6,000,000. No application fee.

European Film Sales (CREA-MEDIA-2027-FILMSALES) is automatic, performance-based support for sales agents handling recent non-national European films on all platforms. The call opens for applications on 29 April 2027.

item.title: Awesome Foundation Local Chapters: USD 1,000 Monthly Micro-grants (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NL, Asia) (rolling)
item.description:
Awesome Foundation (local chapters)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Usually USD 1,000 (or local equivalent) per grant, no strings attached, typically one grant per chapter per month. No application fee.

The Awesome Foundation is a network of volunteer giving circles: in each chapter about ten trustees pool their own money to give a USD 1,000 no-strings micro-grant, usually monthly, to a project that adds "awesome" to their area: art, public interventions, community tech, events, science and civic...

item.title: Kimonos Art Center: Episkeptes Residency, 5th edition (Cyprus; up to EUR 1,250 stipend) (closes 16 Nov)
item.description:
Kimonos Art Center
Deadline: 16 Nov 2026
Award: Up to EUR 1,250 stipend plus up to EUR 250 travel. EUR 25 application fee.

Kimonos Art Center's Episkeptes residency hosts three international visual artists, including video and multimedia artists, for one month, ending with a public presentation. ELIGIBILITY: international visual artists. OFFER: up to EUR 1,250 stipend and up to EUR 250 travel.

item.description:
European Theatre Convention (ETC) with the Akademie für Theater und Digitalität, Dortmund
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 3,000 development grant shared between the two partner theatres, plus up to EUR 2,860 from ETC for the Digital Expert's travel, accommodation and subsistence. The theatres must put the Digital Expert on their payroll at their usual creative fee. No application fee.

ETC's Digital Theatre Programme pairs two member theatres from different countries with a Digital Expert to research and develop artistic uses of technology in theatre: motion capture, coding, mixed, augmented and virtual reality, robotics and interaction design.

item.description:
Sodas 2123 (Vilnius) and Titanik A.i.R / Arte ry (Turku)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: Stipend of EUR 1,000, travel expenses covered, free accommodation (25 m2 studio apartment) and a 20 m2 working studio. Food, local transport, materials and insurance are the resident's own cost. No application fee stated.

An exchange residency between Sodas 2123 (Vilnius) and Titanik (Turku), the only sound art residency in Finland. WHO: emerging and established artists based in Lithuania working in sound and sonic practices, or where sound meets performance and/or digital media; solo artists or duos.

H401 (Stichting Herengracht 401), within the EU-funded WONDER project led by ECCOM

Award: Artist fee of EUR 3,000, production costs reimbursed up to EUR 1,000, plus travel, accommodation (if applicable) and subsistence under EU travel guidelines. Travel and accommodation for the final event in Rome are also covered. No application fee stated.

Frankfurt LAB and KfW Stiftung
